name: Helicopter Events

features.text: Default-disabled dedicated-only rotor audio probe with expiring server snapshots; offline-tested, native runtime NOT TESTED.
Default-disabled, server-resolved read-only Army Walkie Talkie preflight diagnostic; no authorization or inventory mutation.
Military Air Support equipment, original-card custody, single-use authorization, following, officer loot and combat; not implemented.

Two locally optimized wreck-site assets, one static mesh/material per site. Default-disabled decorative upright probe at fixed ground 8871,8253,0 uses explicit server-validated admin intent, one native object and a per-process attempt latch; offline-tested only. No automatic spawning/regeneration, loot, destruction or collision promise.
Dynamic crash materialization, structural destruction and durable crash-site recovery retain their Lua-only NO-GO contracts.
User-selected transparent helicopter mod icon; original project thumbnail and fallback/poster art preserved. Offline PNG checks only; native UI appearance NOT TESTED.

limits: Source/offline review only. Native GLB/materials, physical scale, large-mesh culling, Linux/headless delivery/save/restart and dedicated correctness NOT TESTED. G7 BLOCKED / NOT TESTED; stable-release G8 BLOCKED. No military support gameplay or SP/host placement. No Workshop item.
